Settings contains application preferences and individual server profiles. Up/Down selects a field; Left/Right selects an action; Enter edits or activates it. Apply changes runtime preferences; Save also writes the configuration. Connection changes take effect on a subsequent connection.

Choice popups keep every option reachable on small terminals. Escape closes the popup or returns through the settings screens. Help preserves unsaved settings and the current selection. In a text or password editor, ? remains ordinary input.

The transfer screen lists incoming offers and retained transfer progress. Up/Down selects a transfer or field; Left/Right selects the action; Enter activates it. Accept and Send open forms for review. The file browser can fill a source path before an offer is sent. Escape returns without accepting an offer.
DCC transfers use a direct, unencrypted connection and expose the selected network address to the peer. A received offer alone does not open files or a connection.
